Dmytro Havrylov is a PhD candidate in Materials Engineering in the Canadian Centre of Welding and Joining at the University of Alberta. Dmytro joined the CCWJ in September, 2016. Prior to it, Dmytro was a lead engineer in the E.O. Paton Electric Welding Institute in Kiev, Ukraine. He obtained his B.Sc. and M.Sc. degrees in Applied Mathematics and Physics at Moscow Institute of Physics and Technology. 

Dmytro received University of Alberta Doctoral Recruitment Scholarship (2016) and Captain Thomas Farrell Greenhalgh Memorial Graduate Scholarship (2017).

Dmytro is a co-author of Sengupta, V., D. Havrylov, and P. F. Mendez. "Physical Phenomena in the Weld Zone of Submerged Arc Welding—A Review." WELDING JOURNAL 98.10 (2019): 283S-313S.



## Project

Dmytro's research focus is on the development of simple formulas that predict the effect of molten metal flows in a weld pool on weld shape and penetration.
